useful_changes: one hypothesis and pinned task packet
observe existing running campaign before taking another task
host: Current Windows host; existing research lock, ownership/PID-create_time guards and heartbeat remain authoritative
execution: At most one heavy campaign. Source preparation can overlap. Ready tasks should continue after actual terminal audit rather than wait for an idle poll.
helper_scope: A small typed filesystem transition CLI with meaningful pure filesystem tests; it does not start models, Qwen, Codex sessions, services or remote workers
admission: Draft is not pending. Pending requires exact frozen source, input/split/evaluator/control pins, real resource/budget protocol, dependencies and execution readiness. Existing METH/LOSS/KERN program IDs are references, never duplicate launches.
recovery: Running task is never automatically requeued because a PID disappears or communication is lost; preserve task hash, original clocks and first failure. Fresh owned root/descendant/preparer closure and actual exec status remain mandatory before any next launch.
publication: Build packet in staging then rename on the same filesystem only after validation; metrics may be null on failure, zero is not a substitute. Technical completion, quality and audit completeness remain separate.
not_implemented_by_this_proposal: new scheduled task or duplicate automation
